rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: Zuma's inauguration address, issued by the Presidency on 9 May 2009, says of Nelson Mandela: 'When Madiba took the oath of office on the 10th of May 1994, it was one of the greatest historic moments of our country'.

locator.section: tributes to predecessors, paragraph on Madiba

rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The same address says that 'In June 1999, former President Mbeki came to this very podium to take the oath of office, as the second President of the Republic'.

locator.section: tributes to predecessors, paragraph on Mbeki

rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The Presidency's text of Zuma's address on the occasion of his inauguration as the fourth democratically elected President, Union Buildings, 9 May 2009; those addressed include Speaker Max Sisulu and Chief Justice Pius Langa.

rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: In the address Zuma says: 'Today, as I take this solemn Oath of Office as the Fourth President of the Republic of South Africa'.

locator.section: paragraph after the tributes to Mandela, Mbeki and Motlanthe

rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The address thanks 'President Kgalema Motlanthe' for his service to the nation.

locator.section: tributes to predecessors, paragraph on Motlanthe
